title: Club amateur radio call sign licence records, 23 April 2020 (Ofcom FOI 00896085)
dataVintageNote: the disclosed list is named 'Copy of Club Call Signs 23 04 20', dating the export 23 April 2020; the response letter (received 8 April 2020, dated 30 April 2020) states it holds licences live or cancelled after 1 April 2014. The 23 April export date sits between request and response, consistent with a report generated to answer the request.

relatedEntries.relation: the nearest general amateur-register snapshot held (allocated callsigns, 26 March 2020); this club-only disclosure is a scoped subset - club licence records rather than the whole register - from four weeks later.

copy-of-club-call-signs-23-04-20.pdf.contentsIndicative: the disclosed club-callsigns list itself, as an Excel-for-Office-365 Save-As-PDF (41 pages, two columns 'Call sign / T-number' | 'Status'). 2,049 data records: 1,613 Live, 258 Surrendered, 178 Terminated. It is a per-licence-record list (live licences plus licences cancelled after 1 April 2014), so 209 callsigns recur - G0TRG appears four times (Live once, Surrendered twice, Terminated once). 12 records carry a status with an empty callsign cell (all Terminated, on pages 39-41), a genuine feature of the disclosed document confirmed by two independent routes. The column header names 'T-number' but no T-number token appears in the data - every non-blank value matches the ordinary callsign shape. Preserved verbatim; the parse source is the transcription extract club-callsigns.csv.

club-callsigns.csv.contentsIndicative: byte-deterministic transcription extract of the Save-As-PDF (header callsign,status,page,row_on_page; CRLF; 2,049 data rows). page and row_on_page are the record's position in the disclosed document (positional provenance), carried in the extract but not into the normalised projection. Reproduces byte-identically from the committed PDF via the committed extractor (self-check src/shared/pdf-table-extract.test.ts): 2,049 rows, per-status counts Live 1,613 / Surrendered 258 / Terminated 178, 4,088 text operators reconciling to 4,088 shows, 209 recurring callsigns, 12 blank-callsign rows, 0 shape oddities.

normalised--club-callsigns.csv.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status; 2,049 rows sorted by callsign (the PDF page/row order is layout, not a meaningful assertion order) with the whole row as tie-break, so the recurring per-licence records and the 12 blank-callsign rows are all preserved. Status carries the source's own Live / Surrendered / Terminated verbatim. No whitespace trimming was needed.

00896085-club-amateur-radio-call-signs.p.contentsIndicative: the 00896085 response letter (Emma Leech, Information Rights Adviser, dated 30 April 2020): records the request as received 8 April 2020 and states the attached list holds all club amateur radio callsigns that are live or were cancelled after 1 April 2014 - Ofcom does not hold records of licences cancelled before that date.
